:::{#exr-prereq-write-recursion}
#### Writing a recursive function

Write a recursive Python function `total(xs)`
that returns the sum of the numbers in the list `xs`.
Do not use a loop or the built-in `sum`.
You may use `xs == []` to test for the empty list,
`xs[0]` for the first element
and `xs[1:]` for the list without its first element.

:::
